# Task context

[按任务读取 Zeron 规范](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/skills/zeron-page-builder/references/task-context.md). New application: choose a standard shell; existing page: preserve the host; small control change: read only relevant contracts.

# Zeron UI for agents

Read the catalog and exact installed types before choosing a component.

- [AI usage](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/docs/ai)
- [Catalog](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/ai/catalog.json)
- [Skills installation](https://zeron-ui.vercel.app/skills/install.md)

## Install

Use the verified Zeron CLI. Start with init when components.json is missing; inspect add --dry-run before installing. React 19 and Tailwind 4 are required; Next-only blocks must not be directly installed in Vite. Workspace @zeron/ui imports do not establish consumer import paths.

## Design rules

Use semantic tokens and public variants, sizes and icon slots. Preserve keyboard focus, loading and disabled states. Reuse the host shell, assign one scroll owner per region, and replace demo data with real callbacks. A clean static check is not runtime verification.

- Task-matched canvas width: use centered narrow layouts (PageLayout size="md" or max-w-3xl) for forms, settings, billing, and wizards; use bounded full-width layouts (PageLayout size="full") for dense tables, dashboards, and split AI workspaces.
- Zero box-in-box noise: never wrap a main table or list inside PageContent (already a floating surface) in an extra Card or Container; prefer 0.5px border-hairline dividers or whitespace.
- 90-8-2 color restraint: 90% neutral 5-tier Surface hierarchy, 8% high-contrast text/icons, <=2% brand or status accents; at most 1 primary/neutral button per task region.
- First-screen density caps: <=4 MetricCards per row and <=3 visible toolbar filters; collapse secondary actions into a Dropdown.
- Control & motion alignment: adjacent Input, Select, and Button controls must share the same size; pass icons via useIcon to leadingIcon/trailingIcon slots instead of raw inline SVGs.

The complete guide collection exceeds the context budget. Read every linked classification index and its ordered parts; no source text has been discarded.
